source_name: NovaPay — corporate documents and financial statements page
why_relevant: The best-disclosing non-bank payment institution in Ukraine: publishes audited consolidated financial statements of the NovaPay non-banking financial group (2025 statements posted 2026-05-15), licences, and an English 'NovaPay today' profile. First non-bank to receive the extended NBU licence allowing accounts and card issuance.

source_name: NovaPay Credit — bond investor page (облігації)
why_relevant: Genuine investor-relations surface for a non-bank payments group: 14 bond issues to date, first wartime public-offer corporate bond, uaAA rating from Standard-Rating. Bond prospectuses and issuer reports carry volumes and financials no competitor publishes.

source_name: Portmone.com — company / about page (corporate profile)
why_relevant: Corporate surface of a market-leading Ukrainian online payments provider, 100% owned by Kaspi.kz's fintech arm since 2021 — which makes Portmone's results reportable inside a listed foreign parent's filings, a rare path to audited numbers for a Ukrainian PSP.

source_name: Portmone blog (blog.portmone.com.ua) — company news and business section
why_relevant: The de facto press room for Portmone: product launches, merchant partnerships and occasional volume claims. Ukrainian PSPs rarely run a formal newsroom, so the marketing blog is the press-release channel.

source_name: Fondy — legal / public offer and licence disclosures (fondy.ua/uk/legal)
why_relevant: Fondy's legal pages name the operating entity (ТОВ ФК 'ЕЛАЄНС'), its financial-institution certificate (ФК №419, 22.10.2013) and its NBU payment-services licence (30.04.2023 №21/778-рк) — the identifiers needed to pull statutory filings and register entries for the brand.

source_name: YouControl — company dossiers for Ukrainian PSP legal entities
why_relevant: Aggregates state-register data, beneficial ownership, charter capital and filed financial statements per EDRPOU — the practical route to financials for private PSPs that publish nothing (confirmed dossier for ТОВ ПОРТМОНЕ, EDRPOU 31868613, charter capital 9,080,698.49 UAH).

source_name: Opendatabot — company profiles and change alerts by EDRPOU
why_relevant: Second aggregator over the same state registers, with an API and change-monitoring (director, ownership, court cases, insolvency). Useful as a cross-check on YouControl and for event-driven alerting on PSP entities.

source_name: data.gov.ua — Annual financial statements of enterprises dataset (Фінансова звітність підприємств, річна)
why_relevant: Bulk open dataset of filed annual financial statements, filterable by EDRPOU — the only free route to balance-sheet and P&L data for private payment institutions that never publish a report. Resources exist per reporting year (e.g. FY2023 filings).

source_name: EMA Association (Асоціація ЄМА) — members list and payment market news
why_relevant: Industry body whose membership spans payment systems, financial companies, payment providers and MFIs — an actor-map generator that surfaces PSP names absent from search. Also publishes recurring 'Новини платіжного ринку від ЄМА' digests and lobbying positions (e.g. on interchange cuts).

source_name: PaySpace Magazine (psm7.com) — Ukrainian fintech and payments trade press
why_relevant: Sector trade press that runs comparative analytics of Ukrainian payment services (e.g. a nine-player market review) and reports quarterly card-payment aggregates. Frequently the only public place where private PSPs volunteer volume figures, via interviews and awards.

source_name: Finclub (finclub.net) — Ukrainian financial-sector news outlet
why_relevant: Covers regulatory and market developments affecting non-bank payment institutions (interchange, licensing, association lobbying) with more financial depth than general media.

source_name: Forbes.ua — investigative company profiles of payment groups
why_relevant: Publishes ownership and business-model reconstructions of opaque payment operators (who owns the IBox terminal network; NovaPay's debut public bond issue). Reveals-indirectly source for firms with no disclosure.

source_name: Mind.ua — investigations into LeoGaming / IBox ownership and payment-market conflicts
why_relevant: Ran sustained reporting on the LEO payment system, LeoGaming Pay, IBox and their shareholder, including litigation over the coverage. Documents the entity web (LEO system: IBOX Bank, ComInBank, Sky Bank, Concord Bank plus 18 non-bank institutions incl. ФК 'Свіфт Гарант' / City24 and ФК 'ЛеоГеймінг Пей') that no register presents in one place.

source_name: Interfax-Ukraine — corporate finance wire on payment institutions
why_relevant: Wire service that reports PSP bond placements, licensing and oversight decisions with dated, quotable specifics (e.g. NovaPay's 14th bond issue, series 'N', UAH 200m via NovaPay Credit; the unchanged 2025 list of key payment infrastructure objects).

source_name: Minfin.com.ua — securities pages for non-bank payment issuers
why_relevant: Tracks outstanding corporate bond series, coupons and yields for payment-sector issuers, giving a market-priced read on their credit standing where no equity listing exists.

source_name: Kinstellar client briefing — New Payment Services Law (UA)
why_relevant: Law-firm analysis mapping the new licence categories (payment institution, e-money institution, branch of a foreign payment institution) and the register/licensing mechanics — a fast orientation layer over dense regulation, and a pointer to further legal-sector commentary.

source_name: Ukrainian Bar Association digital blog — payment systems commentary
why_relevant: Practitioner commentary on how payment systems are structured and supervised in Ukraine; useful for glossary building and for identifying which obligations bind non-bank providers.

source_name: M.E.Doc accountants' blog — NBU payment system registration procedure explainers
why_relevant: Compliance-practitioner explainers that flag changes in registration and reporting procedure quickly and in plain Ukrainian; an early-warning layer on new filing duties for payment providers.

source_name: NBU — Payment systems and infrastructure oversight section (Оверсайт платіжної інфраструктури)
why_relevant: The National Bank of Ukraine is both the regulator and the payment organisation of the national card scheme PROSTIR; its payments section is the authoritative hub for scheme rules, registries, oversight reports and card/POS statistics.

source_name: NBU — Financial market infrastructure oversight report (Звіт з оверсайту інфраструктури фінансового ринку)
why_relevant: Annual oversight report is the single richest structured disclosure on card scheme volumes, switch/processing operators, systemically important payment infrastructure and PROSTIR performance — the earnings-proxy dataset for the UA payments sector.

source_name: PROSTIR — National Payment System official site (Національна платіжна система «ПРОСТІР»)
why_relevant: Primary disclosure channel of the domestic card scheme: participant lists, product launches, e-Secure penetration, acceptance-network news. Also a strong POINTER to member banks, processors and acquirers.

source_name: NBU — List of important payment infrastructure objects (Перелік важливих об'єктів платіжної інфраструктури)
why_relevant: Annually names the systemically important schemes and processors (e.g. PrJSC Ukrainian Processing Center, LLC EJSI DISKI PROTSESSING, LLC TAS LINK). Effectively the NBU's own ranking of who matters in switching/processing.

source_name: NBU — Payments market trends presentation (Стан та тенденції на ринку платежів України)
why_relevant: Slide-deck series giving headline card counts, POS terminal counts, acceptance points, transaction volumes and scheme split — quick, quotable quantitative series between full reports.

source_name: NBU quarterly payments digest (Дайджест платіжного ринку / Digest)
why_relevant: Quarterly digest explicitly carries a 'Нові учасники ПРОСТІР' (new PROSTIR participants) section plus infrastructure updates — highest-frequency official signal on scheme membership growth.

source_name: NBU Annual Report (Річний звіт Національного банку)
why_relevant: Contains a payments-infrastructure chapter summarising card issuance, acceptance network and PROSTIR development for the year; useful as a cross-check on the oversight report.

source_name: Ukrainian Processing Center (UPC) — corporate site, ПрАТ «Український процесинговий центр»
why_relevant: Largest non-bank card processor in Ukraine (Raiffeisen Bank International group), NBU-designated important infrastructure. Publishes client/volume claims, product launches and partnerships — a proxy for processing-market share and for which banks outsource processing.

source_name: UkrCard / УкрКарт — processing centre and ATM network operator (РАДІУС, АТМоСфера)
why_relevant: One of the largest non-bank processing centres (since 1998) and operator of ~2,000-unit RADIUS and ~2,000-unit ATMoSfera ATM networks; authorises/clears for Visa, Mastercard and UnionPay. Direct disclosure on ATM/POS acceptance infrastructure.
